about: What Gantry5 buys, with a price per unit to plan with. Estimates in euros, incl. VAT, for single pieces from a hobby shop; check before ordering. gantry5.py says how many of each a variant needs.

vslot-2020.name: V-slot 2020 extrusion
vslot-2020.supplier: OpenBuilds-type V-slot, cut to length (Dold Mechatronik, Ooznest, AliExpress)

vslot-2040.name: V-slot 2040 extrusion
vslot-2040.supplier: as 2020; longer than 3 m: two pieces joined over a post

cable-4core.name: Shielded 4-core cable for steppers, UV-stable sheath

birch-ply-12.name: Birch plywood 12 mm
birch-ply-12.supplier: timber merchant; cut on a CNC or by jigsaw from the DXF printed 1:1

aluminium-6.name: Aluminium plate 6 mm (5083 or 6082)
aluminium-6.supplier: online cutting service from the DXF (water jet or CNC)

larch-45x195.name: Larch heartwood, untreated, 45 x 195 mm
larch-45x195.supplier: sawmill or timber merchant; or Douglas fir

tie-rod-m10.name: Threaded rod M10, stainless A2, with washers and nuts

v-wheel.name: Mini V wheel kit (wheel, bearings, spacer)

t8-screw.name: Lead screw T8 x 8 with brass nut and coupler

end-switch.name: End switch (micro switch, normally closed wiring)

controller.name: FluidNC controller, ESP32 with TMC2209 drivers (e.g. the Jackpot board)

pi5.name: Raspberry Pi 5, 8 GB, with case, cooler and 27 W supply

pi-ssd.name: microSD 64 GB (or an NVMe hat and SSD)

psu-24v.name: Power supply 24 V, 150 W (e.g. Mean Well LRS-150-24)

estop.name: E-stop mushroom, twist to release, NC contact

contactor.name: Contactor 2 NO, 24 V DC coil: the e-stop cuts motor and valve power through it

valve.name: Solenoid valve 1/2 inch, normally closed, 24 V DC, brass

valve-relay.name: Relay module for the valve (driven by the controller's coolant output)

flow-meter.name: Flow meter 1/2 inch, Hall pulses (YF-S201 class)

nozzle.name: Watering nozzle, brass, with 8 mm hose

soil-probe.name: Soil moisture and temperature probe, capacitive, I2C

camera.name: Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 with a 1 m ribbon

enclosure.name: Enclosure IP65, about 300 x 200 x 120 mm, with cable glands

fasteners.name: Fastener kit: M5 bolts and T-nuts, M3 for motors, M2 for the camera

liner.name: Root barrier and liner, EPDM or HDPE, per m2
